_provenance.implementation: Checked against native nodes_yue2.py and the user-supplied yue2_full.json. Toolkit prompt budgets and duration recommendations are policies, not model specifications.

profiles.engine: MiniMax Music 3 diffusion (DiT) + MiniMax text encoder
profiles.conditioning_description: One long-form production caption: Global Metadata, Vocal Details and a chronological Arrangement. Roughly 250-450 words.
profiles.lyrics_description: Section tags alone on their own line, lyric words underneath.
generation_nodes: MiniMax Music 3 subgraph (MiniMaxMusic3TextEncode, EmptyMiniMaxMusic3LatentAudio, KSamplerWithConfig, MiniMaxSafeAudioDecode)
notes: The MiniMax text encoder rejects a caption+lyrics prompt above 5000 tokens; the parser trims to the configured budget instead of letting the encoder fail.
Generation and the whole audio chain of the shipped example are unchanged by the YuE2 addition.

profiles.engine: YuE2-3B auto-regressive score + semantic planner with an acoustic flow-matching stage
profiles.conditioning_description: Detailed global musical identity and chronological arrangement, synchronized section by section with Lyrics. Roughly 250-450 words for a full song.
profiles.lyrics_description: Singable text with section tags such as [Verse] and [Chorus]. No engineering directions or ABC notation.
notes: The native ComfyUI implementation shares 24576 context tokens with generated music at 25 frames per second. The context must also accommodate ABC and instruction tokens; the text budget is not a guaranteed maximum duration.
The 4500-token parser budget is a toolkit estimate, not a YuE2 tokenizer measurement or a model-specific text limit.
max_duration is a ceiling. Neither repeated section tags nor a requested duration guarantee an exact song length.
Full and melody modes explicitly generate ABC before music. SheetSage2 is only needed for audio-to-score covers, not new songs.
Native output is 48000 Hz. Release sample rate is selected independently.
